title: Florida Saltwater Fishing Charters
specs: Access to multiple fisheries including Mosquito Lagoon, Ponce Inlet, nearshore reefs, and offshore Gulf Stream
Target species include redfish, snook, trout, mahi, snapper, grouper, sharks, tarpon, and sailfish
Fish cleaning and filleting included at no extra charge
No fishing license needed; covered by captain's charter license
Suitable for all skill levels including beginners and kids
Capacity varies by trip and vessel; most trips accommodate small groups, families, and friends
Can coordinate two boats for large groups with advance planning

options.name: Inshore Fishing Charter
options.detail: Fishing in calm, protected waters targeting redfish, snook, trout, and others.

options.name: Nearshore Fishing Charter
options.detail: Fishing 3-9 miles offshore targeting sharks, bonita, tarpon, Spanish mackerel, and flounder.

options.name: Offshore Fishing Charter
options.detail: Deep sea fishing 10+ miles offshore targeting mahi, wahoo, snapper, grouper, tuna, and pelagic species.

blurb: Guests fish inshore, nearshore, or offshore waters targeting species like redfish, snook, trout, mahi, snapper, grouper, and sharks. Trips include a licensed captain, fishing gear, bait, licenses, and fish cleaning. Suitable for all skill levels including beginners and kids.
extraNote: Deposits are non-refundable · Trips canceled within 48 hours of departure are not eligible for refund · Trips may be rescheduled or refunded if unsafe weather prevents trip · Captain makes final decision on weather-related cancellations · Most trips depart from a private dock in New Smyrna Beach next to Outriggers Tiki Bar and Grille; may also meet at Ponce Inlet, Edgewater, Oak Hill, or Mosquito Lagoon boat ramps depending on trip.
